start_test_server: start a gRPC aio test server on localhost with optional secure credentials and interceptors
TestServiceServicer_UnaryCall: create a UnaryCall RPC handler that echoes metadata and returns a SimpleResponse with payload
TestServiceServicer_StreamingOutputCall: build a StreamingOutputCall RPC handler that yields responses with configurable delays and payload sizes
TestServiceServicer_FullDuplexCall: create a FullDuplexCall RPC handler that processes streaming requests and yields responses with delays
create_extra_generic_handler: build a generic RPC handler to programmatically register extra methods like UnaryCallWithSleep not in the proto file
